text: July PCE rose 0.2% monthly and 3.7% annually; core PCE rose 0.2% and 3.3%. Goods prices fell 0.1% while services rose 0.3%. Personal income increased 0.4% and spending increased 0.2%.

meta.note: Monthly price components remain uneven across goods and services.

text: DOJ and SEC inquiries cover accounting for transactions involving two TWG insurers and related companies. TWG states no fraud occurred, says it has submitted a plan addressing regulatory concerns, and denies that sports assets are being sold to fund insurance operations.

meta.note: No wrongdoing has been alleged by DOJ or SEC; reported transaction concerns remain under inquiry.
